newsitem.title: USA: Bridger 550 MW unit 3 seen back on-line by Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Bridger 550 MW unit 3 seen back on-line by Thurs.

text.p: The 550 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Jim Bridger coal-fired power plant in Wyoming will likely be back on-line by Thursday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Tuesday.
The unit was still in the process of restarting after being shut for unplanned repairs early last week, they said.
Bridger's 550 MW unit 2 was shut Friday for planned maintenance, which was expected to finish at the end of May.
The plant's other two 550 MW units were said to be operating normally.
The Bridger plant is owned by PacifiCorp and Idaho Power Co.
